prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption pet personality traits selector redesign: Redesigns the pet choice screen with personality trait badges and a spotlight layout to help users find their companion quickly. (why: Adoption step dropoff is severe (60.9% conversion, median 89s), indicating decision fatigue during friend selection.)
1: [home, new_flow] Waiting time pet interaction teaser flow: Introduces a mini companion preference quiz screen right before generation waiting to engage users while waiting. (why: The waiting step has high median (201s) and mean (2336s) times, causing user drop-off due to boredom during generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account sign-in data sync hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that authenticating syncs and preserves pet data. (why: Top support complaint (8 emails) is users losing pets or finding accounts reset after signing in again.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop pet activation welcome copy: Updates the finish headline and body text to explain where the pet appears on screen and how to click to interact. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails on confusion about controlling or hiding pets.)
4: [adoption, layout] Upload photos split layout view: Switches the photo upload screen to a split view showing clear photo requirements next to the drop area. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird output visuals caused by bad source photos.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting screen completion alert toggle: Enables notification options on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering finishes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s; alerting users when ready prevents lost users who switch away while waiting.)
